title: Weights, offsets, and mixed models: agreement with R and lme4
label: R compatibility
checked: Weighted and offset GLMs against base R, and Gaussian mixed models (REML and ML, random slopes, several terms, nesting) against all four lme4 optimizers with both phit optimizers.
reference: R glm(), lm(); lme4 lmer() with bobyqa, Nelder_Mead, nlminbwrap, and nloptwrap
inputs: tests/fixtures/r-compatibility.json (fixed models) and tests/fixtures/lmm-expanded-r.json (mixed models, including sleepstudy).

comparison.applies_to: weighted and offset GLMs against base R
mixed-model estimates, phit bobyqa against lme4 bobyqa
mixed-model estimates for other optimizer pairs
mixed-model log likelihood, AIC, and BIC
